stemMd: Why does the passage compare a slab in a case with a slab underfoot?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To show that stone cannot be displayed

options.label: B
options.textMd: To prove that visitors preferred the new colour

options.label: C
options.textMd: To claim that cases are unsuitable for every museum object

options.label: D
options.textMd: To argue that documentation replaces all physical heritage

options.label: E
options.textMd: To distinguish preserving an object from preserving its former function

explanationMd: The comparison makes the material/use distinction concrete. The same physical stone can survive while its relation to everyday movement changes. That is the central limit of the museum’s preservation strategy.

distractorRationale.c: The comparison is specific to the lost use.
distractorRationale.a: The slab is displayed or retained successfully.
distractorRationale.d: The material itself was also preserved.
